species.name: Raftlet

dex.text: A long-legged spider that sits on a lily pad like a lifeguard, feeling for ripples. Do not mistake it for a friend of the flies.
dex.fact: The fen raft spider can run across the surface of the water, and can dive under it to escape or to hunt.

species.real: The fen raft spider is one of Britain's largest spiders and survives at only a few wetland sites.

species.name: Rafterweb

dex.text: Sits on its raft of sticks, strung with silk, and feels every tadpole in the pond. It is very patient and entirely without pity.
dex.fact: A female fen raft spider carries her egg sac in her jaws, and then builds a nursery web for the spiderlings.

species.real: Fen raft spiders catch small fish and tadpoles as well as insects, and are very sensitive to ripples on the water.
